content:
incident-bot: ALERT: gpu-pool-eu-west-2 saturated (90% queue growth in 10m). Autoscaler errors observed. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:
Sam: on it. pulling logs now.
Alex: I see repeated scaler failures: 'quota_exceeded' from cloud-provider, plus controller reported 'failed to reconcile: resource locked'.
Mira: adding context — traffic spike from batch ingestion job in EU region, high long-sequence generation requests. Queue latency and token backpressure reported by runtime.
Ben: can we temporarily divert new requests to the fallback pool (cpu-ephemeral / lower-throughput)? We should avoid customer-facing 5xxs.
Sam: initiating reroute to fallback model variant and enabling short circuit TTL. @ops-bot run route-switch --src pool:gpu-eu-west-2 --dest pool:cpu-fallback-eu --filter "tenant!=enterprise-sensitive"
ops-bot: running command...
ops-bot: WARNING: 403 Quota API - rate limit on resizing projects. Manual scale may be required.
Jess: Support: customers already posting errors, I'm drafting a short status note for the dashboard and key accounts. No P1 for now but several high-volume tenants impacted.
Alex: Pasting autoscaler controller logs (tail):
```
I0305 02:12:10 controller.go:243] reconcile attempt 12 for pool gpu-eu-west-2
E0305 02:12:10 controller.go:310] scale up failed: provider API error: QuotaExceeded: vgpu-core-cores: limit 128 requested 192
E0305 02:12:11 controller.go:315] reconcile error: resource lock detected: allocation-operator (conflicting op)
```
Sam: looks like two issues: 1) quota hard limit preventing scale-up; 2) operator/lock causing reconcile delays. We need both short-term mitigation and long-term fix.
Mira: short-term: enable token-based shedding on queueing layer and drop very long sequences > 4096 tokens for best-effort path. Also enable prefix-KV reuse to reduce generation cost.
Ben: policy question — do we alert the capacity marketplace team to request emergency quota bump? That can take ~30-60m.
Alex: I've escalated a quota request ticket (provider ticket 892341) and messaged cloud-ops on call.
Sam: manual intervention plan: 1) pause non-critical batch ingesters (confirmed with Mira), 2) enable fallback pool routing (ops-bot did partial), 3) add temporary rate-limit on per-tenant ingestion, 4) if quota bump fails, start controlled eviction of low-priority jobs.
Mira: pausing the batch job now: `kubectl patch cronjob scheduled-ingest -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'` — done. Expect queue ingress to drop in ~30s.
Jess: status update ready for customers: "We are investigating a regional capacity issue affecting some EU inference requests. We are routing traffic to fallback pools and expect reduced latency soon. No data exposure. More updates in 30 minutes"
Sam: ops-bot, confirm full route swap status and active pool sizes.
ops-bot: route-switch report:
- requests rerouted: 74% of new EU session starts
- cpu-fallback-eu active replicas: 68 (scaled up within CPU pool limits)
- gpu-eu-west-2 queue length: still high (2.1k requests) but ingress reduced by ~60%
Sam: queue drain rate improved but we're hitting throttling in the fallback path — some tenants are hitting API-level rate limits because they have bursty flows.
Alex: noticed autoscaler controller has a lock TTL bug where lock isn't released on failed reconciles. Opening PR to add guaranteed unlock on error path. Short-term workaround: restart allocation-operator pod to clear stale lock.
Ben: do it. Sam please proceed with restart if safe.
Sam: restarting allocation-operator... `kubectl rollout restart deploy/allocation-operator -n infra`
ops-bot: rollout initiated. New pod scheduling...
Sam: new operator pod ready, logs show locks cleared. Controller now attempts reconcile and requests additional GPU nodes but provider still returns QuotaExceeded.
Mira: with batch paused, queue growth stopped and we're now draining at ~300 req/min. Need to keep fallback routing to prevent new inflows.
Jess: support thread: customers reporting transient 429s and elevated latency. Adding note to status page: "Partial service degradation; mitigations in progress".
Alex: creating short-lived soft-fallback model that uses a quantized variant to reduce vGPU cores per replica. Deploying now.
Mira: config snippet for quantized variant sent to infra:
```
model_variant: q4_8
vgpu_cores: 8
batching: adaptive
```
Ben: after quantized variant up, we can shift non-critical traffic back and free up full-GPU instances for high-priority tenants.
Sam: quantized pool is healthy, shifting 40% of queued jobs to q4_8 variant. Queue drop visible.
ops-bot: providers-api: quota-bump request status: pending. ETA unknown.
Alex: propose post-incident actions: (A) autoscaler: ensure unlock-on-error fix merged and added e2e test, owner Alex; (B) capacity policy: increase soft reserve for EU peak hours, owner Ben; (C) admission control: add per-tenant ingestion caps for batch jobs, owner Mira; (D) provider process: SLA for emergency quota bump, owner Lina (product/cloud ops).
Lina: I can coordinate provider SLA work and customer communication templates.
Jess: I'll follow up with impacted customers and provide timeframe.
Sam: timeline recap: 02:12 root alert -> 02:18 batch paused & fallback routing -> 02:32 operator restart -> 03:05 quantized variant in -> 03:25 queue stabilized.
Mira: sanity checks: we preserved outputs for queued jobs — no data lost, persisted KV caches intact.
Alex: creating ops-ticket to track fixes: OPS-4849. Adding checklist and attaching logs.
Sam: adding action items to runbook: update autoscaler unlock behavior, add provider quota detection alert, and ensure fallback model variant pre-warmed for EU.
Jess: support will send out final customer note after postmortem. Suggested wording attached.
Ben: recommend we automate the route-switch sequence in a runbook play so on-call can flip routes with single command. Owner Ben.
Lina: scheduling a 1-hour postmortem tomorrow to review timeline and actions. Invite: SRE, ML infra, Platform, Product, Support.
Sam: marking incident as mitigated. Keeping thread open for action item tracking. :white_check_mark:
Mira: quick follow-up — please add a regression test that simulates provider quota denial to ensure autoscaler handles it gracefully.
Alex: noted. I'll assign tests and a small dogfooding run in staging.
Jess: final note for status page: "Incident mitigated; throughput normalized; postmortem and next steps will follow."
ops-bot: Incident closed flag set by Sam at 03:40.
Sam: thanks team. I'll follow up with the postmortem doc in #eng-postmortems and link OPS-4849.
Mira: action items captured: Mira: ingestion caps policy; Alex: autoscaler unlock fix & tests; Ben: route automation playbook; Lina: provider SLA; Jess: customer comms; Sam: postmortem writeup.
Ben: adding tentative due dates on the ticket.
Alex: uploading debug logs and heap snapshots to shared bucket: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/3589023456/
Jess: prepping final summary for execs.
Sam: closing thread here, continuing offline for writeup.
